name: Fast Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression
definition: FCGS is an autoencoder-based compression approach for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses a hyperprior structure and context models to compress Gaussian attributes (geometry and color) into a latent space, addressing the fidelity drop caused by MLP non-invertibility in geometry attributes.
summary: Fast Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression is an autoencoder method that encodes 3D Gaussian attributes into a latent space using hyperpriors and context models without altering original Gaussian positions.
